items.title: Corning (GLW) Stock Looks Like A Bargain On Cash Flow
items.summary: Corning has delivered a very large 3 year share price gain, yet the recent pullback leaves a sharper question for you as an investor. Over the past 3 years the stock has returned about 3.1x, which puts a lot of weight on whether the underlying cash generation fully backs that kind of move.
